baseline_models.focus_anchor: The finite verb and its named event repeat the root و ق ع at focus words 2 and 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction does more than predict an event: the repeated root moves the named Event from futurity into occurrence and from occurrence into fixed reality.

activation_trace.role: Falling that becomes fixed reality makes the doubled verb-event construction an actualization threshold.

changed_reading.before: A future event simply happens on that day.
changed_reading.after: On that day the named Event drops out of futurity and becomes fixed, binding actuality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root names both the occurring and the Event, allowing manner-images within و ق ع to color the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Occurrence is rendered as a hard downward arrival whose force is registered as impact, not as a neutral point on a timeline.

activation_trace.role: The severe descending calamity supplies the event's downward force and unwelcome weight.
The heard strike turns occurrence into an impact that leaves a perceptible effect.

changed_reading.before: The clause only dates an occurrence.
changed_reading.after: The clause announces a severe descent arriving with the force and trace of a blow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 2 and 3 share a root whose inventory repeatedly joins falling to a place where the fall settles.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Event can be followed spatially: it falls, finds or makes a landing place, and remains there as a settled condition or residue.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall and its landing places supply a fall whose destination matters as much as its onset.
A bird alighting on a perch supplies the transition from motion to situated rest.
Water retained in a hollow supplies the settled aftermath left where the Event lands.

changed_reading.before: The Event is a time-bound happening without a spatial remainder.
changed_reading.after: The Event is a landing that establishes a new site and leaves reality settled in its wake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening designation of fixed truth and the closing removal of doubt bracket the focus, converting its lexical fall into both ontological fixation and epistemic closure.

activation_trace.role: Falling into fixed reality anchors the focus as the moment actuality becomes irreversible.
Reality fixed in correspondence against falsehood supplies the opening ontological pole.
Knowledge fixed after doubt disappears supplies the closing epistemic pole.

structural_cues: 69:1-3 repeatedly names and questions the opening event-title, while 69:51 closes with a certainty formula.
The focus itself repeats one root as finite verb and event-noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed reality and fixed knowledge; I infer that their bracketing turns the focus into an actuality threshold. A live alternative is that they certify the Event without defining how it occurs.

changed_reading.before: The Event becomes real in the ordinary sense that a prediction comes true.
changed_reading.after: The Event is the threshold at which denied reality becomes fixed in being and no longer permits epistemic retreat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier striking and felled bodies, followed immediately by one coordinated crushing of earth and mountains, specify the focus impact as a single leveling collision.

activation_trace.role: The forceful heard strike anchors the Event as impact rather than mere temporal arrival.
One thing striking another supplies the collision pattern rehearsed before the focus.
Bodies thrown down onto the earth show impact translated into a flattened human result.
Different things united in one direction coordinates earth and mountains into one stroke.
Pounding and demolition through to leveling supplies the immediate physical result of the Event's impact.

structural_cues: The focus follows the single blast and single crushing without an intervening scene.
Earlier destroyed people are pictured already thrown down like hollow trunks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collision, prostration, unity of direction, and leveling; I infer one causal impact that links them. A live alternative is that these are separate consequences gathered around, rather than constitutive of, the Event.

changed_reading.before: The Event descends severely but its physical action remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The Event arrives as one coordinated blow that transfers bodies, earth, and mountains onto a leveled plane.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near context repeatedly changes what can bear what: earth and mountains are themselves lifted, the sky opens and loses strength, and the throne is borne. The Event lands when the ordinary support system is dismantled and reassigned.

activation_trace.role: Alighting on a perch anchors occurrence as a relation between a descending body and its support.
Lifting an externally visible load reverses the usual role of earth and mountains as bearers.
Opening by fracture removes the continuity of the upper enclosure.
Slackening weakness makes the sky cease to function as a stable support or cover.
The fixed framework or support of an order supplies the contrasting structure that remains explicitly borne.

structural_cues: The focus is positioned between the lifting and crushing below and the splitting and weakness above.
Carrying recurs on both sides of the focus, first for earth and mountains and then for the throne.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lifting, fracture, weakness, and an explicitly borne framework; I infer a system-wide reassignment of support relations. A live alternative is that these are adjacent signs with no shared load-bearing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Event lands inside an otherwise stable cosmic container.
changed_reading.after: The Event is the landing produced when the world's ordinary relations of bearing, enclosure, and rest are revoked and reassigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's expectation branch is completed by a person's prior expectation, face-to-face meeting, and reckoning: what had been projected ahead now arrives and meets its subject as a counted reality.

activation_trace.role: Awaiting and casting expectation supplies the event while it is still projected into the future.
Falling into fixed occurrence supplies the conversion from projection to actuality.
Certainty reached through an indication makes prior anticipation warranted without making it present yet.
Two opposed things arriving face to face turns awaited reckoning into personal encounter.
Counting and account specify what the person finally meets when the Event occurs.

structural_cues: After the focus, public exposure leads into book-distribution and first-person retrospective speech.
The successful speaker explicitly links former anticipation to present encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expectation, certainty after a sign, meeting, and counting; I supply the temporal arrow from anticipated account to encountered account. A live alternative is that ظ ن ن already denotes certainty, but the future-to-present conversion still remains.

changed_reading.before: The Event is an objective cosmic occurrence outside the observer.
changed_reading.after: The Event is when one's projected reckoning crosses the distance and arrives as a face-to-face, counted encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of focus occurrence as an official written mark is activated by documentary reminder, a written entry that obligates judgment, and a cutting decision. The Event can therefore be read as a verdict entered into force.

activation_trace.role: A written notation or official mark supplies the focus with an administrative mode of becoming effective.
A document preserving an established right gives the reminder a latent documentary function.
A written establishment that obligates a ruling or decree supplies the record's binding force.
A cutting judgment converts the binding record into an executed verdict.

structural_cues: A reminder before the focus becomes individual books displayed and read after it.
The two book-recipients are separated by opposite hands and opposite outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies official notation, a right-document, obligatory writing, and cutting judgment; I infer the legal-administrative arrow from record to execution. A live alternative is that the books only evidence an Event caused elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The Event occurs as a natural or cosmic happening.
changed_reading.after: The Event occurs like a recorded judgment receiving its final mark and thereby entering into force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Occurrence fixes what had been latent into manifest reality: persons are displayed, concealment is removed, visible and invisible domains are paired, and covering culminates in the pain of being uncovered.

activation_trace.role: Fixed occurrence anchors disclosure as a change in reality, not merely a change in description.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies the Event's public display function.
Removal of hiddenness supplies the transition from latent condition to manifest state.
Direct sight supplies one side of the text's paired visible and invisible field.
Stripping away a covering makes regret the affective result of disclosure.
Concealing truth supplies the prior covering that the Event renders unsustainable.

structural_cues: The first repeated 'on that Day' after the focus introduces universal presentation with nothing hidden.
Later the text pairs what is seen with what is not seen, then joins covering to regret.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies display, removal of concealment, sight, uncovering, and covering; I infer that the Event functions as their disclosure threshold. A live alternative is that disclosure follows the Event as one consequence rather than defining its occurrence.

changed_reading.before: The Event changes the external world through impact.
changed_reading.after: The Event also forces hidden persons, records, and commitments to land in public, inspectable reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future hard descent has a prior verbal landing: earlier catastrophe is made a reminder, the present discourse is delivered downward, and its reception can place the hearer in protection before the Event lands materially.

activation_trace.role: The severe descending Event anchors the later material landing for which the message prepares.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies the warning's preparatory function before the focus.
Delivering something downward supplies a verbal descent that precedes the Event's hard descent.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the possible response enabled by the warning's prior arrival.

structural_cues: 69:12 turns a remembered catastrophe into a reminder held by a receptive ear before the focus.
69:43 and 69:48 later identify the discourse as a descent and again as a reminder for those who protect themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, downward delivery, and self-protection; I supply the causal arrow by which the message's prior landing prepares for the Event's later landing. A live alternative is that descent only authenticates the warning and does not pre-enact the Event.

changed_reading.before: The future Event is isolated from the present act of hearing about it.
changed_reading.after: The Event has an advance verbal landing in the reminder, allowing reception now to alter how its later material landing meets the hearer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's explicit non-dominant split mapping from و ق ع to ق و ع, so it is form-distant and must not be presented as a direct lexical translation. It remains anchored by the focus mapping and is contextually activated by immediate pounding-to-leveling; downstream prose should label it a resultant-terrain image rather than a resolved sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root is explicitly split-mapped to a branch for a spread-out level place, while both focus words carry the mapped source occurrence.

activation_trace.role: A spread-out level place lets the Event momentarily image the terrain resulting from its own occurrence.
Flattening and lowering immediately before the focus provide the mechanism that produces the level field.

changed_reading.before: The Event is only what happens to the world.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Event also names the spread-out level condition the world becomes when the blow lands.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rainfall and pooling images are genuine focus branches but a meteorological synthesis is cross-domain and not demanded by the clause. Abundant water before the focus and a rain-venting weakness after it keep the activation anchored; downstream prose should call it a precipitation analogy, not identify the Event with ordinary weather.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dominant focus inventory includes both rain landing and water retained where it falls.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall and its landing sites supply precipitation as a concrete model of occurrence.
Water settling in hollows supplies the retained result after the fall.
Water appearing and becoming abundant supplies the earlier overflow phase of the analogy.
A cloud's outlets bursting with rain supplies the later failure of containment above.

changed_reading.before: The Event descends as an abstract calamity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it precipitates across the cosmos, breaking upper containment and collecting as a settled new condition below.

strongest_changes: The doubled focus root became an actuality threshold bracketed by fixed truth and certainty.
The immediate sequence specified occurrence as one leveling impact rather than an unshaped catastrophe.
Expectation, meeting, and account personalized the Event as projected reckoning arriving face to face.
Presentation and uncovering added disclosure of latent states to the Event's physical action.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's verb-event repetition supported several mechanisms at once: fixation, impact, landing, support reassignment, disclosure, and an exploratory official-entry model. The packet's split root mapping also preserved a rare resultant-terrain reading instead of forcing every branch into the dominant root.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly supplies consequences around the focus, but whether impact, disclosure, and support failure define the Event or merely follow it remains open.
The official-entry and prior-verbal-landing readings depend on reader-supplied causal links and should remain exploratory.
The level-field outlier depends on a non-dominant split mapping, and the precipitation outlier is a cross-domain analogy rather than a settled lexical sense.
